title: chilling playing minesweeper, checkers, and tic tac toe in lobby on my looking for group app for gamers
author: Unfair-Frosting-4934
selftext:
it’s been fun just enjoying what I’ve built. Have gotten some pretty rancid responses from users on Reddit so just sharing here 

(Current theme , the neon green, is a purchased theme from the store and not the default look) 

Created LobX, an LFG for gamers. I’ve added some things you can get in the Overdrive Store (premium store) for the in app currency which is earned through participating on the app. They’re things like colored themes, /commands for your lobby and now I’ve added some small mini games you can play no sweat while in a lobby waiting. 

Added tic tac toe, minesweeper and checkers to start. It’s been fun even though often times just sitting in lobby by myself. Working on getting the Google play app finished thru testing
